concept.title: What is subtract of numbers
concept.shortdesc: Here you will learn what is subtraction

conbody.p: Subtraction is the process of finding the difference between two numbers by taking one number away from another.
When using a calculator, you enter the first number, press the minus (–) button, enter the second number, then press equals (=) to get the result.
It shows how much remains after removing one value from another.
